items.title: Ukraine's army targeted in new charity-themed malware campaign
items.description: Officials of Ukraine's Defense Forces were targeted in a charity-themed campaign between October and December 2025 that delivered backdoor malware called PluggyApe. [...]

items.title: New VoidLink malware framework targets Linux cloud servers
items.description: A newly discovered advanced cloud-native Linux malware framework named VoidLink focuses on cloud environments, providing attackers with custom loaders, implants, rootkits, and plugins designed for modern infrastructures. [...]

items.title: 'Most Severe AI Vulnerability to Date' Hits ServiceNow
items.description: ServiceNow tacked agentic AI onto a largely unguarded legacy chatbot, exposing customers' data and connected systems.

items.title: Microsoft Starts 2026 With a Bang: A Freshly Exploited Zero-Day
items.description: The vendor's first Patch Tuesday of the year also contains fixes for 112 CVEs, nearly double the amount from last month.

items.title: CrowdStrike to Acquire Browser Security Firm Seraphic for $420 Million
items.description: News of the move to acquire Seraphic comes less than a week after CrowdStrike announced an agreement to acquire identity security startup SGNL for $740 million. The post CrowdStrike to Acquire Browser Security Firm Seraphic for $420 Million appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: Central Maine Healthcare breach exposed data of over 145,000 people
items.description: A data breach last year at Central Maine Healthcare (CMH) exposed sensitive information of more than 145,000 individuals. [...]

items.title: Belgian hospital AZ Monica shuts down servers after cyberattack
items.description: Belgian hospital AZ Monica was forced to shut down all servers, cancel scheduled procedures, and transfer critical patients earlier today due to a cyberattack. [...]

items.title: New Windows updates replace expiring Secure Boot certificates
items.description: Microsoft has started rolling out new Secure Boot certificates that will automatically install on eligible Windows 11 24H2 and 25H2 systems. [...]

items.title: Adobe Patches Critical Apache Tika Bug in ColdFusion
items.description: Adobe has released patches for 25 vulnerabilities across its products, including a critical Apache Tika flaw in ColdFusion. The post Adobe Patches Critical Apache Tika Bug in ColdFusion appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: Microsoft Patches Exploited Windows Zero-Day, 111 Other Vulnerabilities
items.description: Two vulnerabilities patched this month by Microsoft were disclosed publicly before fixes were released. The post Microsoft Patches Exploited Windows Zero-Day, 111 Other Vulnerabilities appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: Shadow#Reactor Uses Text Files to Deliver Remcos RAT
items.description: Attackers use a sophisticated delivery mechanism of text-only files for RAT deployment, showcasing a clever way to bypass defensive tools and rely on the target's own utilities.
